subdivision_of_building: Ground Floor and Part Second Floor.

building_details.building_ref: No new buildings (Existing building info below)

description: Retrospective application for change of use of the ground and part second floor from the existing community / educational use to include a place of worship
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The terms of this planning permission shall be fully implemented no later than 31 December 2022 or the use hereby approved shall be abandoned and the premises vacated

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 786/AF/PP-011A received 16 December 2021; 786/AF/PP-021; 786/AF/PP-111; 786/AF/PP-110; and Caneparo Associates Travel Plan dated October 2021; received 3 November 2021 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The building shall be used as a Place of Worship or for educational use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in in Class F1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 and its subsequent amendments, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting the order) no change of use of the premises shall be carried out.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for worship and religious education shall not be carried on outside the following times: 07:00 to 22:00 hours Monday to Saturday and 09:00 to 21:00 hours Sunday and Public and Bank Holidays and no amplified music shall be played in or outside the premises permitted for this use in association with the approved use.
Unless otherwise first agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority, no amplified sound shall be played that is audible outside the premises at any time and the doors to the premises shall be kept shut at all times other than for access

Condition : 5 - Within three months of this decision, the cycle parking spaces and the access to them shall be provided in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing 7257/08 Rev D and such spaces shall be permanently available for the users of the building(s) without obstruction.  The long term cycle parking spaces shall be enclosed by a secure, roofed and lockable enclosure.  These arrangements shall be retained permanently

Condition : 6 - Within three months of this decision, the electric vehicle charging arrangements shown on the approved plans shall have been installed and made available to users of the parking spaces.  All other car parking spaces on site shall have been equipped within six months of the date of this decision with wiring to enable subsequent installation of electric charging points for which charging points shall be subsequently installed if demand requires.  These shall be retained permanently
Reason: To support sustainable transport objectives in accordance with adopted local plan policy EC2
Within three months of this decision, the electric vehicle charging arrangements shown on the approved plans shall have been installed and made available to users of the parking spaces.  All other car parking spaces on site shall have been equipped within six months of the date of this decision with wiring to enable subsequent installation of electric charging points for which charging points shall be subsequently installed if demand requires.  These shall be retained permanently

Condition : 7 - The operators of the premises shall inform the Local Planning Authority in writing at least one month before any large events (including festival events) that are intended to attract more than the usual daily worship attendances numbers take place and in advance of any event planned to be held at the site that exceeds the capacity of the premises to accommodate all those attending within the building are intended to take place.  The activities shall not proceed unless acknowledgement of receipt of the notification has been obtained from the local planning authority and shall not exceed the hereby approved hours of operation unless formal written approval has been obtained from the local planning authority.

Condition : 8 - Within two months of the date of this decision, the applicant shall submit to the local planning a document comprising a fire safety audit of the premises and outlining the fire safety measures necessary to ensure that the building complies with relevant fire safety standards and shall thereafter make amendments to the document that shall be requested by the local planning authority and put it into effect immediately thereafter and continue to operate these measures permanently.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the details included in the submitted travel plan hereby approved, the applicant shall submit in writing to the local planning authority a further revised travel plan within three months of the date of this permission to include the following additional provisions:
"	An extension to the duties of the traffic marshals to include measures for managing a waiting taxi or taxis blocking the road, to direct it (them) to a more suitable location or to wait temporarily in the site forecourt on a managed basis if the events / prayers are overrunning significantly.
"	Revisions to reflect the correspondence between the applicant and the local planning authority up to and including the email from Caneparo Associates dated  16 December 2021
The travel plan shall be implemented immediately as currently submitted and thereafter updated when the subsequent measures and revisions described above have been approved by the local planning authority.
The Travel Plan shall be subject to an annual review by a qualified traffic consultant and if any revised measures are necessary in order to continue to meets its objectives and best transport planning practice, these shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and implemented immediately on approval.  The travel plan shall be kept in effect for the duration of the use hereby approved.

Condition : 10 - Within three months of the date of this decision, the applicant shall submit for approval by the local planning authority a strategy that it will thereafter put into effect to encourage visitors to disperse from the adjoining street without unnecessary delay after any event that they have attended and to do so quietly and without causing unnecessary disturbance for nearby residents (for example by avoiding littering, shouting or noise from the use of vehicles in surrounding streets) so far as the applicant is able to achieve this.  Once the document has been approved, the measures so agreed shall be put into effect permanently for the duration of the use
